mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 250.0 indicates sustained high inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100.0) signals expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1500.0 (thousands of units) signals strong residential construction activity that indicates robust consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signal a severe economic downturn with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary regime defined by UNRATE > 8.0 and HOUST < 1400 indicates declining consumer spending and business activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0 and HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
